content.description: Illustration showing hands lifting up the brake cylinder and inserting a bolt into the torque plate hole

items.title: LIFT UP CYLINDER
steps: (b) Insert a bolt into the torque plate hole to secure the cylinder.

items.text: REMOVE ANTI-RATTLE SPRINGS, PAD GUIDE PLATES AND SUPPORT PLATE

content.description: Exploded view of brake assembly showing anti-rattle springs, pad guide plates, and support plate components

items.text: INSTALL NEW PAD SUPPORT PLATE, NEW PAD GUIDE PLATES AND NEW ANTI-RATTLE SPRINGS

content.description: Front view of brake caliper assembly showing both sides with brake pads installed

items.title: INSTALL NEW PADS AND NEW ANTI-SQUEAL SHIM
steps: (a) Install the pads onto each spring.

content.text: Install the outside pad to the wear indicator is at the top side.
Do not allow oil or grease to touch the rubbing face.

content.description: Detailed view of brake pad installation showing anti-squeal shim placement

steps: (b) Install the anti-squeal shim toward the inside of the pad.

content.description: Illustration showing the lowering of the brake cylinder with bolt removal from torque plate

items.title: LOWER CYLINDER
items.text: Remove the bolt from the torque plate and lower the cylinder.

content.text: Insert the cylinder carefully so the boot is not wedged.

items.title: INSTALL CYLINDER INSTALLATION BOLT
items.text: Install and torque the cylinder installation bolt.
